#### Frequently Asked Questions

#### [Question 1. What is e-Shram and its purpose?](#collapseOne1)

e-Shram is a comprehensive National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW) launched by the Government of India under the Ministry of Labour & Employment. Its primary purpose is to facilitate delivery of welfare benefits and social security measures to unorganised sector workers across the country. The platform aims to register and provide identity cards to unorganised workers, enabling them to access various government schemes, benefits, and services more efficiently.

#### [Question 2. Where can I access e-Shram services?](#collapseTwo)

e-Shram services can be accessed through e-Shram portal. You may visit e-Shram portal online at  [http://www.eshram.gov.in.](http://www.eshram.gov.in) From there, you can register for an account, apply for benefits, update your information, and avail various services offered under the e-Shram initiative.

#### [Question 3. Who are unorganised workers?](#collapseThree)

Any worker who is a home-based worker, self-employed worker or a wage worker working in the unorganised sector and not a member of ESIC or EPFO, is called an unorganised worker.

#### [Question 4. What is unorganised sector?](#collapseFour)

Unorganised sector comprises of establishment/ units which are engaged in the production/ sale of goods/ services and employs less than 10 workers. These units are not covered under ESIC & EPFO

#### [Question 5. What is UAN?](#collapseFive)

UAN or Universal Account Number is a 12 digit number uniquely assigned to each unorganised worker after registration on e-Shram portal. UAN is a permanent number i.e., once assigned, it will remain unchanged for any worker.

#### [Question 6. What should I do if I encounter technical issues with the e-Shram portal?](#collapseSix)

If you encounter technical issues while using the e-Shram portal, here are steps you can take to resolve them:   

* **Check Internet Connection:** Ensure that your internet connection is stable and working properly.
  
* **Refresh the Page:**Sometimes, simply refreshing the page can resolve minor display or loading issues.
  
* **Clear Browser Cache:** Clearing your browser's cache and cookies can help resolve issues related to stored data.
* **Try Another Browser:** If the issue persists, try accessing the portal using a different web browser or device.
* **Contact Support:**If none of the above steps resolves the problem, contact the e-Shram portal helpdesk at 14434 for assistance. They can provide further troubleshooting steps or escalate the issue to the technical team, if necessary.
  
* **Provide Details:** When contacting support, provide details about the issue you are experiencing, including any error messages or specific actions that led to the problem. This information will help them diagnose and resolve the issue more effectively.
* **Keep Updated:**Check for any announcements or updates on the e-Shram portal or official communication channels regarding known technical issues or maintenance periods.

#### [Question 7. How can I stay informed about updates and changes to e-Shram services?](#collapseSeven)

To stay informed about updates and changes to e-Shram services, you can follow these steps:

* **Official Website:**  Visit the official e-Shram website regularly www.eshram.gov.in. Important announcements and updates are posted on the Portal.
* **Social Media:** Follow e-Shram on social media platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc. Updates and announcements are shared on these channels to keep stakeholders informed.

#### [Question 8. Is there any helpdesk I can contact to address my queries?](#collapseEight)

A dedicated National Help desk has been setup for any queries related to e-Shram registration and grievances. Helpdesk Number is 14434/18008896811 (9.00 AM to 6.00 PM - Daily including Sundays).

#### [Question 9. I am unable to connect to the helpdesk number – 14434/18008896811. What should I do?](#collapseNine)

Due to high call volume, there may be a scenario where a call could not be connected to helpdesk number 14434/18008896811 (9.00 AM to 6.00 PM - Daily including Sundays). In such case, you are requested to try again after some time or you may raise your grievance through online portal [https://gms.eshram.gov.in.](https://gms.eshram.gov.in)

#### [Question 10. Are there any income criteria?](#collapseTen)

There are no income criteria for registering on e-Shram as unorganised worker. However, the worker should not be an income tax payee.

#### [Question 11. Are there any age eligibility criteria to register on e-Shram?](#collapseTwelve)

Any worker who is unorganised and aged between 16-59 years, is eligible to register on the e-Shram portal subject to fulfilling of other criteria.

#### [Question 12. What essential documents are required by the worker to register on e-Shram?](#collapseThirteen)

Following is required by the worker to register on the e-Shram portal–   

* Aadhaar Number
* Aadhaar linked Mobile number.
  

**Note:** If a worker does not have Aadhaar linked mobile number, he/ she may visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or State Seva Kendra (SSK) and register through biometric authentication.

#### [Question 13. What is the benefit an unorganised worker will get when he/she registers on e-Shram portal?](#collapseFourteen)

Central Government has developed e-Shram portal which is a centralised database of unorganised workers seeded with Aadhaar. It is envisaged that this portal will be used to facilitate delivery of various social security benefits to unorganised workers. In emergency and national pandemic like situations, this database may be utilised to provide necessary assistance to the eligible unorganised workers.

#### [Question 14. How unorganised workers can register on e-Shram portal?](#collapseFifteen)

An unorganised worker may register himself/ herself by visiting e-Shram portal or through assisted approach by visiting nearest CSC.

#### [Question 15. Is there any charge the worker must pay for registration on the e-Shram portal?](#collapseSeventeen)

Registration on e-Shram portal is free. Workers are not required to pay any charges to any registering entity.

#### [Question 16. Does the e-Shram card have validity period?](#collapseEighteen)

The e-Shram card never expires.

#### [Question 17. Does the worker have to renew the UAN card?](#collapseNineteen)

No, there is no need to renew the e-Shram card. However, it is recommended to keep the details on the card updated.

#### [Question 18. Who can update workers details on e-Shram?](#collapseTwenty)

Workers can self-update their details by visiting e-Shram portal or through CSC’s.

#### [Question 19. How can a worker update his/ her personal information on e-Shram?](#collapseTwenty3)

Updating your personal information on e-Shram can typically be done through the following steps:   

* **Login:** Log in to your e-Shram account using your credentials (UAN and OTP).
  
* **Edit Information:** Look for options to edit or update your personal details such as address, contact information, Banking details etc.
  
* **Save Changes:** After making the necessary updates, be sure to save the changes by clicking on the "Save" or "Update" button.
  
* **Verification (if required):**Depending on the information being updated, you may need to verify your changes through a confirmation email or OTP (One-Time Password) sent to your registered mobile number or email address.

#### [Question 20. What is NCO?](#collapseTwenty4)

NCO stands for “National Classification of Occupation”. It is prepared on the basis of work and skill levels required to execute the work. It is an international practice and uniform across the country. It helps in comparing, classifying, sorting occupations and skill levels.

#### [Question 21. How to select the matching occupation which worker is currently doing?](#collapseTwenty6)

At the time of registration on eShram Portal, a worker is required to select his activity in the form of occupation which he/ she is currently doing.

#### [Question 22. How occupation is different from skill?](#collapseTwenty7)

A skill is a learned or natural ability to accomplish a particular task whereas an occupation is a person's usual or principal work or business, especially as a means of earning a living.

#### [Question 23. How my details will be used by the Labour ministry?](#collapseTwenty8)

e-Shram is a centralised database seeded with Aadhaar. It will be used for facilitating delivery of social security benefits as implemented by Central & State Governments. It will also ensure portability of the social security and welfare benefits to the migrant and construction workers at their working places. It may also be used for providing assistance to the eligible workers during any National crisis like COVID-19 in future.

#### [Question 24. What if after registration on e-Shram the unorganised worker moves to organised sector?](#collapseTwenty9)

In case if a worker moves to unorganised sector, he/ she will only be entitled for benefits defined for organised sector workers.

#### [Question 25. Whether I must give proof of my date of birth and income?](#collapse1)

At present there is no need to provide any proof of date of birth and income.

#### [Question 26. Where do I go to solve my grievance?](#collapse2)

You may call on national helpdesk to register your grievance or register your grievance on e-Shram Grievance portal (gms.eshram.gov.in).

#### [Question 27. Are there any educational qualifications prescribed for registering as an unorganised worker?](#collapse3)

No, the worker is required to be employed in the gainful employment in the unorganised sector.

#### [Question 28. What are the documents that are to be submitted at the enrolment Centre?](#collapse4)

Worker is not required to submit any document at the CSC’s. They are required to carry their Aadhaar number & Mobile number for registration.

#### [Question 29. What action is required to be taken by the worker, after attaining the age of 60 years?](#collapse5)

Worker do not need to take any action after attaining the age of 60.

#### [Question 30. Who will operate the helpdesk/ grievance redressal mechanism?](#collapse6)

Ministry of Labour & Employment is managing national helpdesk/ grievance redressal mechanism.

#### [Question 31. Is there any interactive map for finding the nearest location of the registration Centre?](#collapse7)

Yes, please click on the link below to find your nearest CSC Centre for assisted registration - [https://findmycsc.nic.in/csc.](https://findmycsc.nic.in/csc)

#### [Question 32. Can the worker update his/ her photo on e-Shram portal?](#collapse8)

During the registration, photo is retrieved from Aadhaar services. Therefore provision to update photo on eShram is not available. However, if worker’s photo is updated in Aadhaar, same will be reflected on e-Shram portal as well after completing Aadhaar re-eKYC on eShram.

#### [Question 33. What is occupation?](#collapse9)

A person's usual or principal work or business, especially as a means of earning a living is called occupation.

#### [Question 34. What is primary occupation?](#collapse41)

The activity which is major source of income for a worker is called his/ her primary activity/ occupation.

#### [Question 35. What is secondary occupation?](#collapse42)

Any other activity which is a minor but significant source of income is called secondary activity/ occupation.

#### [Question 36. I have changed my registered mobile number. How can I update my mobile number? or register other mobile number on e-Shram portal?](#collapse44)

You can login on e-Shram through “Update profile using Aadhaar” under “Already registered” menu and update the new mobile number as your registered number. If you do not have Aadhaar registered mobile number, you may also visit nearest CSC/ SSK’s to update mobile number.

#### [Question 37. Are farmers eligible to register on e-Shram portal?](#collapse45)

Agriculture labours and landless farmers are eligible for registration in the e-Shram portal.

#### [Question 38. I am 16 years old. Can I register on e-Shram portal?](#collapse46)

Yes, you are eligible provided you satisfy other registration criteria.

#### [Question 39. Whether my data will get verified from EPFO, ESIC or tax department?](#collapse47)

Yes, the data will be validated periodically by ESIC, EPFO and income tax departments.

#### [Question 40. What are the details workers can update in e-Shram?](#collapse48)

Once registered, a worker may update his particulars such as mobile number, current address, occupation, educational qualification, skill types etc. through e-Shram portal or by visiting nearest CSC Centres.

#### [Question 41. What is last date of e-Shram Registration?](#collapse49)

There is no last date for registration. For the convenience, registration on e-Shram portal is allowed 24 x 7.

#### [Question 42. Are there any financial/ monetary/ cash benefits after registration on e-Shram portal?](#collapse50)

Right now, only registration is being done through e-Shram.

#### [Question 43. Is e-Shram accessible for individuals with disabilities?](#collapse51)

Yes, e-Shram aims to be accessible for individuals with disabilities. The platform strives to adhere to accessibility standards to ensure inclusivity for all users.

#### [Question 44. Where can I find announcements or news related to e-Shram?](#collapse52)

Visit the official e-Shram website regularly [www.eshram.gov.in.](https://www.eshram.gov.in/) Important announcements and updates are often posted on the homepage.

#### [Question 45. How can I provide feedback or suggestions for improving e-Shram services?](#collapse53)

Go to the official e-Shram website. Look for a section or link related to feedback, contact information, or customer helpdesk on 14434. On Mobile app look for Grievance section in Menu tab. Submit your grievance on the link provided.

**Introduction:-**

According to the survey carried out by the National Statistical Office (NSO) during the year 2017-18, there are around 38 crore workers engaged in unorganised sector in India. At present, there is no centralised database for the unorganised workers. In the absence of such centralised database, Central Government, as well as State Government, are finding it difficult to address the issue of the unorganised workers including those of Migrant workers and Construction workers. A comprehensive data of unorganised & Migrant workers shall help extend social security schemes to them. The Central Government has created a national portal to facilitate the registration of the unorganised workers including migrant workers, which are the most vulnerable section of the labour force through a National Data Base of Unorganised Workers (NDUW).

**e-SHRAM Portal:-**

Ministry of Labour and Employment has developed e-SHRAM portal  ([www.eshram.gov.in](http://www.eshram.gov.in)) for creating a National Data Base of Unorganised Workers (NDUW), which will be seeded with Aadhaar. It consists of Name, Occupation, Address, Educational Qualification, Skill Types, Family details, Bank details etc., so has to extend the benefits of the Social Security Schemes to them.

**Unorganized Workers Categories:-**

The Union Government has identified 409 categories of unorganised workers, inclusive of  Building and Other Construction workers, Agriculture Laborers, Fishermen, Asha Workers, Domestic Workers, Drivers, Tailors, Street Vendors,Etc can register [(To get the list of unorganised workers click here )](https://ksuwssb.karnataka.gov.in/storage/pdf-files/E-Shram%20379 Categories List AA.pdf)

## E-Shram Portal: World’s Largest Database of Unorganised Workers

### From registration to recognition, a revolutionary journey

**Introduction to the E-Shram Portal**

The **E-Shram Portal** is a flagship initiative by the Government of India to support and empower the unorganized workforce, which forms the backbone of the nation’s economy. Launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment on **26th August 2021**, this portal is designed to create a comprehensive **National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW),** verified and seeded with Aadhaar, enabling the delivery of targeted welfare schemes and benefits. By leveraging technology, the E-Shram Portal ensures that workers gain access to social security, job opportunities, and financial inclusion, fostering a more equitable and resilient labor ecosystem. Registration on the E-Shram portal is free of cost. A total of **Rs. 704.01 crores** were allocated for NDUW for the period **FY 2019-20 to FY 2024-25.**

By December 19, 2024, the E-Shram portal has **30,48,02,313** registrations. Beneficiaries can register themselves by visiting e-SHRAM portal ([www.eshram.gov.in](http://www.eshram.gov.in)) or by visiting nearest Common Services Centres (CSCs) & State Seva Kendras (SSKs).

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image003HEB0.png)

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image003HEB0.png)

**Objectives of E-Shram Portal**

**Key Features of the E-Shram Portal**

The E-Shram Portal offers several user-centric features:

**Eligibility for Registering on E-Shram Portal**

To register on the E-Shram Portal, workers must meet the following criteria:

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image004AD9B.jpg)

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image004AD9B.jpg)

**Benefits of the E-Shram Portal**

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image005OX0C.jpg)

![](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/userfiles/image/image005OX0C.jpg)

**Key Development with respect to the E-Shram Portal**

**1. Integration of Gati Shakti Portal with E-Shram Portal**

The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan entails creation of a common umbrella platform of infrastructure projects, pertaining to various Ministries/ Departments, incorporated with a comprehensive database, for efficient planning and implementation, on a real-time basis. The integration of the E-Shram Portal with the Gati Shakti Portal marks a significant milestone in enhancing worker welfare and economic growth. **By aligning infrastructure development with workforce planning, this integration ensures that employment opportunities are generated in tandem with large-scale projects.** Workers registered on the E-Shram Portal can now access job openings linked to Gati Shakti initiatives, promoting equitable economic participation.

**2. International Accolades**

The E-Shram Portal has gained international recognition for its innovative approach to addressing labor market challenges. The portal’s emphasis on inclusivity and digital empowerment has been highlighted as a best practice in workforce management.

**3. Integration with Central Ministries/Departments**

So far, **12 schemes** of different Central Ministries / Departments have already been integrated/ mapped with the e-Shram including Pradhan Mantri Surakhsa Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, Prime Minister Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM-SVANidhi), PM Awas Yojana- Urban (PMAY-U), PM Awas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G), Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).

**4. Integration with other portals**

The **Union Budget 2024-25**, under labour reforms proposed that e-Shram portal would be integrated with other portals to provide one-stop labour services solution and will include mechanism to connect job-seekers with potential employers and skill providers.

#### About e-Shram Portal

The Ministry of Labour & Employment which is one of the oldest and important Ministries of the Government of India, is continuously working on improving life and dignity of Labour force of country by protecting & safeguarding the interest of workers, promotion of welfare and providing social security to the Labour force both in Organized and Unorganized Sectors by enactment and implementation of various Labour Laws, which regulate the terms and conditions of service and employment of workers.

Accordingly, Ministry of Labour & Employment has developed eShram portal for creating a National Database of Unorganized Workers (NDUW), which will be seeded with Aadhaar. It will have details of name, occupation, address, occupation type, educational qualification, skill types etc. for optimum realization of their employability and extend the benefits of the social security schemes to them. It is the first-ever national database of unorganised workers including migrant workers, construction workers, gig and platform workers, etc.

* Between the ages of 15 and 35 years, are eligible for the training programs.
* For women and other vulnerable groups like persons with disabilities, the upper age limit is relaxed to 45 years

* Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) aims to skill rural youth who are poor and provide them with jobs having regular monthly wages or above the minimum wages

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* People working in 25 types of working areas were identified such as, PM Kusum Works, cattle sheds, poultry shed, goat sheds, Shyama Prasad Mukherjee RURBAN mission, workers in national highways, in construction of wells etc. are eligible.

* The scheme will give employment for one hundred and twenty-five days.

* To reward digital transactions

* Promote sustainable Skill Centres for greater participation of private sector.
* Benefit 8 lakh youth over the scheme period (2020-21).

#### Social Security Welfare Schemes

##### [Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-SYM) (Old Age Protection)](https://maandhan.in/maandhan/login)

* Voluntary and contributory pension schemes
* Monthly contribution ranges from Rs.55 to Rs.200 depending upon the entry age of the beneficiary.
* Under this schemes, 50% monthly contribution is payable by the beneficiary and equal matching contribution is paid by the Central Government.

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* Unorganised Workers (working as street vendors, agriculture related work, construction site workers, workers in industries of leather, handloom, mid-day meal, rickshaw or auto wheelers, rag picking, carpenters, fisherman’s etc.
* Age group of 18-40 years
* Monthly income is below Rs.15000 and not a member of EPFO/ESIC/NPS (Govt. funded).

###### Benefits

* After attaining the age of 60 yrs, beneficiaries are entitled to receive monthly assured pension of Rs.3000/-.
* On death of the beneficiary, spouse is eligible for 50% monthly pension.
* If husband and wife, both joins the scheme, they are eligible for Rs. 6000/- monthly pension jointly.

[Site visit](https://maandhan.in/maandhan/login)

##### [National Pension Scheme for Traders and The Self-employed Persons (NPS)](#)

* Voluntary and contributory pension schemes
* Monthly contribution ranges from Rs.55 to Rs.200 depending upon the entry age of the beneficiary.
* Under this schemes, 50% monthly contribution is payable by the beneficiary and equal matching contribution is paid by the Central Government.

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* Shopkeepers or owners who have petty or small shops, restaurants, hotels, real estate brokers etc.
* Age of 18-40 years
* Not covered in EPFO/ESIC/PM-SYM
* Annual turnover not more then 1.5 Crore in rupees

###### Benefits

* Under the schemes, beneficiaries are entitled to receive monthly assured pension of Rs.3000/- after attaining the age of 60 years.

##### [Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Yojana (PMJJBY)](https://www.jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMJJBY.aspx)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* In the age group 18 to 50 years
* Having Jandhan or saving bank account with Aadhaar.
* Auto-debit from bank account on consent

###### Benefits

* Rs.2 lakh on death due to any cause
* Premium @ Rs.436/- year

[Site visit](https://www.jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMJJBY.aspx)

##### [Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMSBY.aspx)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* In the age group 18 to 70 years
* Having Jandhan or saving bank account with Aadhaar.
* Auto-debit from bank account on consent

###### Benefits

* The risk coverage under the scheme is Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death and full disability and Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability.
* Premium @ 20/- year

[Site visit](https://jansuraksha.gov.in/Forms-PMSBY.aspx)

##### [Atal Pension Yojana](https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in/nsdl-forms.php)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian citizen
* Between the age of 18-40 years
* Having bank account linked with Aadhaar

###### Benefits

* The contributor on his choice, can attain a pension of 1000-5000 rupees, or he can also get an accumulated sum of the pension after his death.
* The accumulated amount will be given to the spouse or if the spouse is dead as well then to the nominee.

[Site visit](https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in/nsdl-forms.php)

##### [PDS](https://nfsa.gov.in/portal/PDS_page)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian citizen
* All families below the poverty line is eligible.
* Any family which does not have a member between ages 15 and 59 years of age.
* Any family which has a disabled member is also eligible to avail of benefits under Pradhan Mantri Awas Gramin Yojana
* Those who do not have a permanent job and only engage in casual labour.

###### Benefits

* 35 kg of rice or wheat every month, while a household above the poverty line is entitled to 15 kg of food grain on a monthly basis.
* Being implemented as ONORC to enable migrant workers to receive the food grains wherever they are working.

[Site visit](https://nfsa.gov.in/portal/PDS_page)

##### [Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)](https://pmayg.nic.in/netiayHome/)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian citizen
* Any family including workers, which does not have a member between ages 15 and 59 years of age.
* Any family which has a disabled member is also eligible to avail of benefits under Pradhan Mantri Awas Gramin Yojana
* Those who do not have a permanent job and only engaged in casual labour.

###### Benefits

* Assistance provided to the Beneficiary to the tune of 1.2 Lakhs in plain areas and 1.3 Lakhs in Hilly Areas.

[Site visit](https://pmayg.nic.in/netiayHome/)

##### National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) -Old age Protection

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian citizen
* Any person who has little or no regular means of subsistence from his/her own source of income or through financial support from family members or other sources.

###### Benefits

* Central Contribution @ Rs 300 to Rs 500 for different age group.
* Monthly pension ranges from Rs 1000 to rs 3000/ depending upon state’s contribution.

##### [Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)](https://tms.pmjay.gov.in/OneTMS/loginnew.htm)

###### Eligibility

* Those living in scheduled caste and scheduled tribe households.
* Families with no male member aged 16 to 59 years.
* Beggars and those surviving on alms

###### Benefits

* Health coverage of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization free of cost.

[Site visit](https://tms.pmjay.gov.in/OneTMS/loginnew.htm)

##### Health Insurance Scheme for Weavers (HIS)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* The weaver should be earning at least 50% of his income from handloom weaving
* All weavers, whether male or female, are eligible to be covered under the “Health Insurance Scheme”

###### Benefits

* The beneficiaries would avail a package of Rs 15,000 that includes both pre-existing diseases and new diseases. The division in terms of disbursement of the amount according to the medical conditions stands as- Maternity benefits (per child for the first two)- Rs 2500, Eye treatment – Rs 75, Spectacles – Rs 250, Domiciliary Hospitalisation- Rs 4000, Ayurvedic/Unnani/Homeopathic/Siddha- Rs 4000, Hospitalization (including pre and post)- Rs 15000, Baby coverage-500, OPD and limit per illness- Rs 7500.

##### [Pradhan Mantri Kisan Mandhan Yojana](https://pmkmy.gov.in/)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
* For Small and Marginal Farmers
* Entry Age between 18 to 40 years
* Cultivable land up to 2 hectares as per land records of the concerned State/UT

###### Benefits

* Assured pension of Rs. 3000/- month
* Voluntary and Contributory Pension Scheme
* Matching Contribution by the Government of India.

[Site visit](https://pmkmy.gov.in/)

##### [National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC)](https://nskfdc.nic.in/)

###### Eligibility

* Should be an Indian Citizen
